name: Image -> Editable PDF (ChatGPT mask || ABBYY OCR + style/color)

parameters.formDescription: Upload a raster image (PNG, JPG, JPEG, TIFF, BMP, WEBP). You'll get back a PDF with the text removed from the background and a selectable/editable text layer.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.value: Remove ALL visible text from this image. Reconstruct the background underneath the removed text naturally by continuing the surrounding colors, gradients, and textures. Do not add any text. Do not alter, move, restyle, or recolor any logos, illustrations, photographs, shapes, or layout. The output must contain no readable text anywhere.

parameters.completionMessage: Your editable PDF has been generated and downloaded.
